title: Heinrich Weber: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Working Drafts
version: 2026-06-04 current Weber author record: Volume I recursive audit Batch84, Volume II through section 143
description:
Dedicated Heinrich Weber record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. The top-level PDFs are reader-facing paired English translations and German source transcriptions; broader source material is kept in ZIP artifacts. English translation readers are listed first for each volume so the reader-facing translation surface loads before the paired German source layer.

Status at a glance. [##########] source-checked repair stream: Volume I is complete and now includes the Batch84 recursive source-scan audit correction for printed pp. 7-14; [#######---] Volume II has source-checked cumulative English/German readers through section 143; [#####-----] Volume III has the current repaired cumulative English/German readers. The next continuation points are Volume II section 144, Volume I recursive audit after printed p.14, and Volume III section 101.

Latest update. Replaced the Volume I front-facing English/German readers with the Batch84 scan-audited cumulative versions. Batch84 restores/corrects four compacted or miscopied proof passages in the introduction, with source scan cutouts for printed pp. 7-14, PNG witnesses, render checks, and audit JSON. Volume II remains current through section 143 from the prior Batch82 promotion.

Corrections and contributions. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through the GitHub repository issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
notes: Latest update promotes a Volume I recursive source-scan audit correction for printed pp. 7-14 while retaining Volume II cumulative English/German readers through section 143 and the English-first top-level reader ordering.
